text:
ashley: Heads-up: scheduling a rolling GPU kernel update + ephemeral disk cleanup across EU and US pooled clusters this Thu 02:00 UTC. Expect per-rack cordon + drain ~8-12m, plus ~15m warmup after each rack. @oncall @rajiv please ack.

rajiv: ack. Which pools are affected (hosted vs dedicated)? capacity hit estimate?

ashley: Only pooled/hosted capacity — Dedicated stays pinned/exempt. Estimated capacity hit: 8-12% in eu and 6-9% in us during peak of window. We'll sequence racks to keep regional steady-state.

sophie: Can we guarantee no disruption for Dedicated customers? double-check routing pinning.

ashley: yes Dedicated pools have tag `no-drain` and will be removed from the drain set. Routing policy will prefer dedicated first.

chris: reminder to pre-warm prefix/KV cache after each rack comes back. Add 15m cache warm period and small canary traffic.

maria: ephemeral cleanup might evict some pods with local tmp files — use graceful drain flags:
```
kubectl drain <node> --delete-local-data --ignore-daemonsets --force=false --grace-period=120
# then wait for Ready and run warmup job: kubectl rollout restart ds/prefix-cache-warmup -n inference
```

rajiv: cost note: spot/backfill usage for the window could add ~+$1.2k across regions (estimate). If we spread during off-peak it should be lower.

ashley: will shift heavier racks to 03:00 UTC where possible. I'll open an ops-runbook and a short support comms draft.

oncall: :eyes: I'll be on pager during the window. Set an alert if 95th token latency increases >5% or if available GPU capacity drops >10% for >5m.

infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: https://rwd/ops/maint/1719401110 (owners: ashley, rajiv)

sophie: also enable automatic model-variant fallback in routing for the maintenance period. That will reduce error rates if a host pool is transiently degraded.

ashley: done — enabling fallback policy: 10% traffic to smaller model variant for first 15m after each rack return (A/B test).

chris: I'll capture token latency and per-route cost deltas, dump to interim dashboard. If thresholds breach we'll roll pause.

maria: adding quick smoke checks to run after each rack: `curl -sS https://host:8000/health | jq .` and `python infra/tools/check_kv_cache.py --region eu-west1`

ashley: final checklist I just pushed to the runbook: canary node, capacity gates, warmup timers, support comms, billing estimate. Posting to #customer-commms in 1h.

rajiv: thanks — I'll stand by for any backfill adjustments.

oncall: :thumbsup: will escalate to SRE if any rollback needed.
